test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 27 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

FLOWERS : OLFWSRE :: HOSTILE : SOHTELI :: IMPORTS : ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given terms are:

 The **first and third characters are interchanged & **fifth and seventh characters are interchanged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82764e84a70c33ff24516ec5457b379a904aa1bc11248098bd121ecf3a3dc95e.png] 

 FLOWERS becomes OLFWSRE 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05c6bfcf416da663418a63e947bd4e886022109ff93957a376a34c9a17525f05.png] 

HOSTILE becomes SOHTELI 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7009526f1b730c8f5476d36ac7ae1d261224185e9ace89d11963c74d7e034dc2.png] 

 IMPORTS becomes PMIOSTR

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**
